title: Add rollout ring projection prototype
verified: rollout.rings.show and alias fleet.rollout.show render TUI Rollout Rings as a read-only projection.
The projection defines local, canary, staging and production rings with preview-only status for non-local rings.
The panel exposes read_only=true, projection_controller_only=true, preview_only=true, remote_rollout_authority=false, direct_rollout=false and remote_command_dispatch=false.
The local ring derives readiness from local release provenance, TUI replay, production runbook smoke and ecosystem replay evidence.
Rollback readiness and rollout blockers remain visible, including missing local proof gates and production rollout authority blockers.
Command palette preview describes rollout rings as read-only and explicitly denies remote rollout execution, fleet mutation and rollback execution.
Scripted TUI replay and production runbook smoke both assert rollout rings are projected without remote rollout authority.
risk_notes: Rollout rings are fixture/local-evidence projections only and cannot execute remote rollout commands.
TUI remains projection-controller only and does not gain production signing, rollout, rollback or remote command dispatch authority.
Production rollout remains blocked until future RC0 work supplies production signatures, rollout drills, node-level audit evidence and real fleet authority.
